-- Task answer schema extracted from ms-course-service
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_task_answer (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    filestorage_id uuid NULL,
    started_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    ended_at timestamptz NULL,
    status smallint NOT NULL,
    attempt int NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_task_answer'
          AND column_name = 'student_id'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_task_answer_task_student_idx ON student_task_answer(task_id, student_id)';
    ELSIF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_task_answer'
          AND column_name = 'user_id'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_task_answer_task_user_idx ON student_task_answer(task_id, user_id)';
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_task_answer_auto_review (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_task_answer_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES student_task_answer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    validator_name varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    auto_score numeric(5,2) NULL,
    passed boolean NOT NULL,
    feedback text NULL,
    raw_result jsonb NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_task_answer_review (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_task_answer_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES student_task_answer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reviewer_id uuid NOT NULL,
    checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    final_score numeric(5,2) NULL,
    status smallint NOT NULL,
    feedback text NULL
);
